# 2 bed terraced house for sale

> NEW TO THE MARKET. Located in the popular Brindley Park Estate on the north side of Ashbourne Town, within 2 minutes’ walk of the primary & secondary school campus, Gaa grounds and Ashbourne Town. No 73 is a 2 bedroom mid terraced family home in excellent condition, with parking at the front door and a west facing rear garden. Accommodation of c.72 sq.
